sger gcod/bden pa bden drang de nyid gsal bshad byed rgyu dang / rgyal khab gzhan dang yang na rang gi mi rigs kyi mdun nas gnas lugs de nyid kyi ched rang nyid kyis yod tshad blos btang nas ngo rgol byed pa de yin la/ de yang pha rol po la dma' 'beb byed pa ma yin par rang nyid kyi mngon 'dod de skad gzengs mthon pos brjod pa'am yang na yi ger phab nas 'phred dar 'khyer ba sogs kyi sgo nas ngo rgol byed pa dang / de bzhin zas bcad ngo rgol sogs 'tshe med zhi ba'i 'thab rtsod kyi skor la mang po yod cing mdor bsdus tsam brjod na de tsam yin/dri ba/ mi kha shas kyis rang srog gcod pa ni 'tshe ba red zer la yang kha shas kyis 'tshe med red brjod kyin 'dug pas de'i thad khyed la bsam tshul 'u yod/lan/ nga'i bsam par rang gi khe phan ched ma yin par mi rigs dang rgyal khab ched rang srog 'bul mkhan tsho don dngos kyi dpa' bo yin la 'di la 'tshe ba zhes nam yang 'grel brjod byed 'dod med/ rgya gar rang btsan gyi mes po gran dhi mchog gis kyang 'di 'tshe ba zhig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi med la/ de bzhin a ri'i mi rigs nag portsithob thang rtsod len pa mā ḍin lu'u dir khen gyis kyang de 'tshe bar brjod kyi med/ 'di tsho ni 'tshe med zhi ba'i 'thab rtsod pa'i mes po dag yin// gal srid zas bcad ngo rgol dang rang lus me la phul ba sogs 'tshe ba yin tshe 'tshe med zhi ba'i ches mtho ba'i 'thab rtsod cig med pa red/ 'di ltar song na 'tshe med zhi ba'i 'thab rtsod la nam yang ༄ba 'bras zhig yod khrag po red/
